gaps.where: Inbox → a conversation → the composer in a website chat, client portal, Messenger or Instagram conversation (the reply box and Send)
gaps.gap: The Assistant has no general way to reply in a website chat, client portal, Messenger or Instagram conversation. send_text forces channel 'sms' (tools-write.ts:401) and send_email forces 'email' (tools-write.ts:496). For a chat or portal thread, cannotText tells the model to 'Reply in the chat instead' (tools-write.ts:350-353), which leads nowhere. Two narrow routes do exist. handle_attention_item with action 'reply' sends on the conversation's own channel (chat/portal/messenger/instagram, tools-attention.ts:255, 353-399, 495-525, 604-610), but only for a Home item of kind hot_lead, unanswered_lead or customer_waiting (attention/reach.ts:10-14). decide_teammate_draft can approve an AI draft with the person's own words. Any other 'answer her chat' or 'reply on Instagram' request is refused.
gaps.fix: Add a reply_in_conversation confirm tool (conversationId, body). Its prepare reads conversation.get and refuses sms/email threads (pointing to send_text/send_email). It rehearses message.send with channel = conversation.channel so the composer's own refusals show on the card: Meta's reply window from conversation.get.social, a blocked chat visitor. Title the card 'Reply to {first} in the chat / in their portal / on Messenger / on Instagram?' as tools-attention.ts:500-506 does, with confirmLabel 'Send reply'. Its commit runs message.send {conversationId, channel, body, clientId} without quiet-hours flags. Change cannotText's chat_channel and portal_channel words to name the new tool.

gaps.where: Conversation ⋯ menu → Video call; the phone sheet's Video call; the active call bar's Switch to video
gaps.gap: No tool starts a HandsFreeOS video call with a customer. video_call.start (risk 2, appointments.write) runs only through the worker route /v1/video-calls/start. It is in neither SCREEN_ACTIONS nor NEVER_FOR_THE_ASSISTANT. The coverage test misses it because it only scans for '/v1/commands/<name>'. The command texts or emails the customer their own link itself. That link is /j/<random key>, and only its hash is stored, so the Assistant could never quote it. What it lacks is a way to start the call and hand the person their Join.
gaps.fix: Add a start_video_call confirm tool (personId or conversationId, optional channel 'sms'|'email'). Its prepare rehearses video_call.start and shows a quiet_hours warning; the confirm sets acknowledgeQuietHours, as send_text does. Its commit works out origin the way routes.ts:186-192 does (publicOrigin(tx, workspaceId, webUrl)), runs videoCallStart, and returns outcome '{name}’s link is on its way by text/email' with href `${extra.webUrl}/call/${callId}` (the team's Join, as start-call.tsx:61 opens it). Its words must say the customer's own link went to them and is never shown. Also extend assistant-coverage.test.ts to scan workerPost('/v1/…') routes (apps/web/src/lib/api/worker.ts:437, apps/mobile/src/video-call/start-call.tsx:47) and map each one to its command.

gaps.where: Composer → Ask for a video (sends the customer a link to record and upload a video)
gaps.gap: do_video_link_create exists (SCREEN_ACTIONS, risk 1, so it waits for Confirm), but commitScreenAction throws the command's output away and returns {outcome:'Done', href:null}. The one-time /v/<token> path never reaches the model. The Assistant can make a video-request link and then has nothing to send, and the token is shown only once. The link only works in an SMS conversation (video-link.ts:160-165). Its base is the web app's own address, not the business's public origin: the web uses window.location.origin and the phone config.webUrl.
gaps.fix: Left open: the general part is fixed in the foundations step (a screen action’s answer is kept, and the video link shows whole on its card once, after Confirm); the send_text askForVideo option that texts it in the conversation is the inbox step’s. Give send_text an askForVideo boolean. When it is set, the card says 'Adds a link for them to send a video' and the commit runs video_link.create {conversationId} first, then appends VIDEO_LINK_WORDS.ask(`${extra.webUrl}${out.path}`) to the body before message.send. Refuse it for a non-SMS conversation with the command's notByText words. More generally, have commitScreenAction (tools-screen-actions.ts:128-136) return the command's output, with any `path` made absolute using extra.webUrl, so a screen action's result is never lost.

gaps.where: Phone app → a conversation → the header's Ask HandsFreeOS button
gaps.gap: On the phone's conversation screen, the AppBar is rendered with ask={false}, so its own record-carrying Ask button is hidden. The screen draws its own 'Ask HandsFreeOS' HeaderButton that pushes businessHref(business.id, 'ask') with no ?type=&id=. The ask screen reads the record only from those params (pageRecordOf), so the Assistant never learns which conversation was open. The AppBar's own button passes it through askHref(record), and core's assistantPageRecord supports type 'conversation'.
gaps.fix: In apps/mobile/src/app/app/w/[workspaceId]/inbox/[conversationId].tsx:880, replace router.push(businessHref(business.id, 'ask')) with router.push(askHref(business.id, { type: 'conversation', id: conversationId }) as Href), importing askHref from '@/assistant/page-record'. Or use usePhonePageRecord(business.id).

gaps.where: A conversation's header: the customer, the number or address the thread is with, our line, and the lane switcher (Texts · Email · Chat with unread dots); the ⋯ menu's Copy phone number / Copy email address
gaps.gap: find_conversations already returns personId per row, plus looksLike for an unlinked thread, and get_customer returns the person's phone, email, otherPhones/otherEmails and their conversations with ids and channels. So 'did they also email' and going from a found conversation to the customer are covered. What is still missing is in get_conversation itself and the page context. get_conversation returns only 'with' (a name for a known customer) and no personId. It gives no counterpart (which of their numbers or addresses the thread is with), no line (lineDisplay, our end), and no lanes. context.ts gives only 'Texts with Dana' (and mislabels social, see inbox-21). From the conversation page, 'book her', 'which number did they text' or 'which of our lines' needs a name search or can't be answered, and the number the ⋯ Copy button copies isn't given for a known customer.
gaps.fix: In get_conversation (tools-read.ts:552-560) add personId: conversation.person?.id ?? null, counterpart: conversation.counterpartDisplay, line: conversation.lanes.find(l => l.id === conversationId)?.lineDisplay ?? null, and lanes: conversation.lanes.map(l => ({conversationId: l.id, channel: l.channel, line: l.lineDisplay, unread: l.unreadCount, status: l.status})). All of these are already in conversation.get's ConversationSummary. Add counterpart and line to find_conversations rows. In context.ts's conversation case, add the personId (or the person's name and id) to the page line.

gaps.where: A conversation's messages: photo, video and file thumbnails, email attachments, and 'came by video link'
gaps.gap: get_conversation maps only from/subject/text/status and drops ThreadItem.media. A text, chat or social message that is only a photo or video comes back with no text at all, and 'Sent with your video link' is lost. The only partial route is read_timeline_list on the customer: an email entry's meta.attachments carries the attachment names, as the timeline renders them. That covers email attachments for known customers, not MMS photos, chat/social files or video-link uploads.
gaps.fix: In get_conversation's message mapping (tools-read.ts:568-580), add attachments: i.media.map(m => ({ name: m.name, kind: m.contentType.split('/')[0], cameBy: m.via === 'video_link' ? 'video link' : m.via === 'file_link' ? 'file link' : 'message' })) when media is non-empty. Add media to the conversation.thread type there, and note 'sent N photos/videos' when body is null.

gaps.where: Inbox boxes: My mail (with its Inbox / Other mail / Spam), the Unread toggle, Show more; on the phone, the same chips plus Needs a person and AI
gaps.gap: Counts are reachable through read_inbox_summary (inbox.summary is a screen read): unread per box, waiting, needsPerson, ai, and mail.mine/other/spam. So 'how many are unread' and 'is anything in spam' get a number. find_conversations already covers needs_person and ai, the phone's extra chips. Listing threads is still missing. find_conversations' box enum lacks 'other' and 'spam', though inboxBox has both. It has no mailbox:'mine' (My mail), no unread filter, and no cursor or 'more' flag (max 20). So 'what's in spam', 'show my own Gmail inbox' or 'list the unread ones' can't be answered.
gaps.fix: In packages/core/src/assistant/tools-inbox-crm.ts:39, widen box to z.enum(['mine','unassigned','all','needs_person','ai','archived','other','spam']) and add mailbox: z.enum(['team','mine']).default('team'), unread: z.boolean().optional() and cursor: z.string().optional(). Pass all of them to inbox.list in findConversations (apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-inbox-crm.ts:194-205). Return more: !!nextCursor and nextCursor. Add a 'folder' (Inbox/Other mail/Spam) and 'private' flag to each row.

gaps.where: Each message in a conversation: sent by the AI teammate / approved by, the failure line with its help, Held until…, email From/To/Cc/via, Delivered/Read, RCS buttons and the button the customer tapped, Messenger/Instagram shared post, reply, edited and unsent
gaps.gap: unsent_messages already covers the failure line and Held until: each failed or held message's messageId, why (errorMessage) and goesAt (scheduledFor). read_ai_teammate_review returns runId, messageId and conversationId for the teammate's own sends, which do_ai_teammate_give_feedback accepts (runId or messageId), so feedback on a particular AI reply is possible. Missing from get_conversation: message ids, the AI teammate who sent a message and who approved it (a teammate message reads as from sentBy?.fullName ?? 'the business'), the email from/to/cc addresses and via (own Gmail/Outlook), deliveredAt/readAt, RCS buttons and the customer's buttonReply, social extras, and editedAt/unsentAt. 'Who was it copied to', 'did the AI send that' and 'did she read it' go unanswered.
gaps.fix: In get_conversation's outbound/inbound mapping (tools-read.ts:571-580) add id: i.id, sentBy: i.teammate ? `${i.teammate.name} (AI teammate)` : (i.sentBy?.fullName ?? 'the business'), approvedBy: i.approvedBy?.fullName ?? null, and for email fromAddress/toAddresses/ccAddresses/via. Also add deliveredAt, readAt, buttons (rich labels), buttonReply, social?.kind, editedAt and unsentAt, reading the ThreadItem fields already there. Mention in the tool description that unsent_messages gives why a message failed.

gaps.where: A conversation's thread: the latest 30 plus Show earlier
gaps.gap: get_conversation reads conversation.thread with limit 20 and ignores nextCursor, so it gives no sign that more exist and no way to page back (the screen shows 30 plus Show earlier). The channel enum ['sms','email'] only limits the personId shortcut. A chat, portal or social thread opens fine by conversationId, which find_conversations(personId, channel) and get_customer both return, so that part is a two-step route, not a gap. The description 'texts or email' may still put the model off reading chat or social threads.
gaps.fix: Add before: z.string().optional() (the cursor) and limit (max 50) to get_conversation's input. Pass them to conversation.thread and return more: !!thread.nextCursor and before: thread.nextCursor. Widen channel to z.enum(['sms','email','chat','portal','messenger','instagram']) and change the description to 'one conversation on any channel'.

gaps.where: Inbox list (status, waiting, Show more)
gaps.gap: list_inbox asks inbox.list for 20 open rows sorted by last_message_at and then filters waitingOnly in memory. A customer still waiting behind 20 newer threads is missed, and it never says the list was cut. inbox.list has no 'waiting' filter, so the auditor's fix of passing it to inbox.list doesn't exist. box needs_person is a different thing (handed over by the AI). what_needs_attention (customer_waiting) and read_inbox_summary.waiting do give the waiting customers or their count, which softens this.
gaps.fix: In list_inbox (tools-read.ts:644-650), when waitingOnly is set, follow nextCursor (up to, say, 5 pages) until 20 rows with awaitingReplySince are found. Or add waiting: z.boolean().optional() to InboxListInput and filter on awaiting_reply_since in packages/core/src/queries/inbox.ts. Return more: true when cut, and say so in the card title.

gaps.where: Composer → texting in quiet hours: the choice between Send later (held until quiet hours end) and Send anyway
gaps.gap: send_text always commits with acknowledgeQuietHours: true, and its card's confirm reads 'Send anyway' in quiet hours. It can't use message.send's sendAfterQuietHours, which the composer offers as 'Send at <time>'. handle_attention_item's reply also forces acknowledgeQuietHours. manage_conversation can only cancel a held text, not hold one.
gaps.fix: Add whenQuiet: z.enum(['send_later','send_anyway']).default('send_later') to send_text (packages/core/src/assistant/tools.ts:1322-1332). In sendText.prepare, when t.quiet.quiet, show a field 'Goes' with 'when quiet hours end' or 'now, in quiet hours', and set confirmLabel to 'Send at {end}' or 'Send anyway'. In commit, pass sendAfterQuietHours: true for send_later and acknowledgeQuietHours: true for send_anyway, and report out.scheduledFor in the outcome.

gaps.where: Composer → email: the From choice (a business address or the person's own connected Gmail/Outlook) and Add Cc
gaps.gap: send_email takes only personId/conversationId/subject/body. It sends from the conversation's address or the default (emailTarget picks opts.fromAddressId or the isDefault address), never from one of email.compose_options' other addresses (including the person's own, 'mine') or a connected mailbox (mailboxes[]). It can't add Cc. message.send takes cc (max 10), emailAddressId and mailboxConnectionId, as the composer sends them.
gaps.fix: Add from: z.string().optional() (an addresses[].id or a mailboxes[].id from email.compose_options) and cc: z.array(z.email()).max(10).optional() to send_email. In emailTarget, check from against opts.addresses (usable) and opts.mailboxes and refuse an unknown one with the choices listed. Show 'From' (address, or '{accountEmail} (your Gmail/Outlook)') and 'Cc' on the card. Pass emailAddressId or mailboxConnectionId and cc to message.send in commit (tools-write.ts:494-500).

gaps.where: New message / message sheet → texting another of the customer's numbers; the card's To line
gaps.gap: Choosing another of the customer's numbers can be done in two steps. do_conversation_open (conversation.open is in SCREEN_ACTIONS) takes personId, channel and to, which must be one of their numbers on file, and opens that lane. find_conversations then gives its id for send_text(conversationId). The confirm-card bug is real: textTarget shows To as c.person?.phone (the customer's MAIN phone from conversation.get) ?? counterpartDisplay. When the lane is another number, or when textTarget picks the newest SMS lane for a personId, the card shows a number the text doesn't go to.
gaps.fix: In textTarget (apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-write.ts:283-301), set phone to c.conversation.counterpartDisplay, the lane's actual number, not c.person?.phone. Add the line too: 'From' should use the lane's lineDisplay instead of the business's main fromNumber when they differ. Optionally add to: z.string().optional() to send_text that runs conversation.open {personId, channel:'sms', to} in commit and uses the returned conversationId.

gaps.where: Phone app → Call a customer (call sheet → Call me first / connect me), and the call_customer card
gaps.gap: On the phone, the Assistant's call card has no button. It only shows the name and number, while call_customer's result tells the model 'A Call button is shown; the person places the call.' call.connect_me (risk 2: rings the person's verified cell, they press 1, then the customer) is the phone's only way to call. It is in neither SCREEN_ACTIONS nor NEVER_FOR_THE_ASSISTANT, and the coverage test misses it because the phone runs it through change('call.connect_me'), not '/v1/commands/'. call_customer also takes only personId, so it can't call a conversation's own number or an unknown caller, as the screen's callTarget does.
gaps.fix: Give apps/mobile/src/components/assistant/cards.tsx's CallCard a 'Call' button that runs the phone's startCall({ name, phone, personId }), the same as the conversation header's thread-call at [conversationId].tsx:870-876. Or offer call.connect_me as a confirm screen action (add 'call.connect_me': {} to SCREEN_ACTIONS). Let call_customer take conversationId (using conversation.counterpart for an sms lane) or a phone. Word the result's note by client, e.g. 'A Call button is shown' only where one is. Extend assistant-coverage.test.ts to also scan the phone's change('<command>') calls.

gaps.where: Call cards in a conversation and on the timeline: the recording player, the transcript, the AI summary and suggestions (Notes from the call / CallReview), voicemail
gaps.gap: recent_calls already returns answeredBy and answered, so 'who answered' is covered there. A callId can be reached for a known customer's answered or outbound calls through read_timeline_list (meta.callId, which the timeline uses for PhoneCallNotes), then read_call_suggestion_list(callId). That is a hidden two-step route no tool describes. Still missing: recent_calls drops c.id, personId and conversationId (only an href), and get_conversation's call items have no id, answeredBy or hasRecording. recent_calls says 'Nothing was recorded' whenever transcriptStatus is null, which only means no transcript was asked for. Its fallback href is /app/w/<ws>/calls, a page that doesn't exist (only /call/[callId], a video-call redirect).
gaps.fix: In recent_calls (tools-read.ts:616-639), add callId: c.id, conversationId: c.conversationId and personId from call.log. Base the note on recordingPath: if it's null say 'Nothing was recorded'; else if transcriptStatus is null say 'It was recorded but not written out'. Replace p.calls() with null, or the person's page when conversationId is null, and delete paths().calls (tools-read.ts:27). In get_conversation's call items (tools-read.ts:563-570), add callId: i.id, answeredBy: i.answeredBy?.fullName ?? null and recorded: i.hasRecording. Mention read_call_suggestion_list(callId) in recent_calls' description.

gaps.where: Video call pre-join → Copy the link; a video call card on the timeline
gaps.gap: pre-join's 'Copy the link' appears only in the in-app-browser warning (prejoin-in-app). It copies window.location.href so the person can open it in a real browser; it isn't a share feature. The customer's own link for an inbox call is /j/<key>, stored only as a hash, so no tool could ever return it. What's real: read_video_call_get returns no team Join address (`${webUrl}/call/<id>`). An inbox-started call (no appointment) is found only via read_timeline_list meta.videoCallId (video-call.ts:1057-1068), and only once it has been logged; no tool describes that route.
gaps.fix: In the screen-read executor, add joinUrl: `${webUrl}/call/${call.id}` to read_video_call_get's result when call is not null, and say in the description that the customer's own link went to them and can't be shown. Add recentVideoCalls [{callId, at, host}] to get_customer, from read_timeline_list entries with subtype 'video'.

gaps.where: A conversation the AI teammate handed off: why it handed off, the teammate's note, who took it over
gaps.gap: find_conversations' answeredBy already says 'Waiting for a person' or the name of whoever took it over (takenOverBy). Neither get_conversation nor find_conversations returns why the teammate handed it over (handoffReason) or its note (handoffNote), though conversation.get and inbox.list carry both. 'Why did the AI pass this to me?' can't be answered.
gaps.fix: Add handoff: c.handoffReason || c.handoffNote ? { why: <the same words ai-handling.tsx shows for handoffReason>, note: quoted(c.handoffNote), since: c.needsPersonSince, takenOverBy: c.takenOverBy?.fullName ?? null } : null to get_conversation's result (tools-read.ts:552-560), and the why to find_conversations rows. Reuse the reason labels from the web's ai-handling so the words match.

gaps.where: The AI teammate's draft card in a conversation: an Ask (the teammate asks the person a question) and the add-on flags on a draft
gaps.gap: The auditor misread what an ask is. It is an add-on's action the teammate wants a person to OK on a customer's record (DraftAsk: addonName, operation, summary such as 'Add 412 Oak St to Dana’s homes', recordId), not a question with choices. Who may decide it is anyone who can see that record (canDecide = sees_record), not 'anyone on the conversation'. The rest stands. list_teammate_drafts' kind enum lacks 'ask' (TEAMMATE_DRAFT_KINDS has it), so it can't filter to asks. An unfiltered list shows an ask with no summary, titled as a reply by draftTitle. Add-on flags (fair-housing checks on a reply) aren't returned. A blocked ask gets 'onlyOwnersAndAdminsDecide' and 'Only owners and admins decide…', which is wrong for an ask.
gaps.fix: In packages/core/src/assistant/tools-content.ts:349 use z.enum(TEAMMATE_DRAFT_KINDS). In apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-content.ts, add ask and flags to the Draft preview type. In draftTitle, return `${name} asks: ${d.preview.ask.summary}` for kind 'ask'. Add ask: {addon: addonName, does: summary} and flags: flags.map(f => `${f.addonName}: ${f.message}`) to each listed draft. For an ask with !canDecide, say 'Only someone who can see {record} decides this.' in both the list (replacing onlyOwnersAndAdminsDecide) and decide_teammate_draft's blocked words (tools-content.ts:2755).

gaps.where: Timeline → Log activity: Note / Call / Visit, When, Related lead, Next action
gaps.gap: Two parts are covered already. add_note's input allows personId and leadId together, and the worker passes all of them to activity.log, so a note can be tied to a lead. A lead's next action is set with update_lead (nextAction, nextActionAt), though as a separate confirm step. Missing: add_note always logs kind 'note' with no occurredAt, so 'I called her yesterday at 3' can't be logged as a Call or Visit at that time. It can't attach to a custom record (customRecordId), though ActivityLogInput takes it.
gaps.fix: Add kind: z.enum(['note','call','visit']).default('note'), occurredAt: when.optional() (not in the future) and recordId: uuid.optional() (sent as customRecordId) to add_note (packages/core/src/assistant/tools.ts:1162-1172), and pass them to activity.log (apps/worker/src/assistant/tools-write.ts:202-206). Title the done card 'Call logged on {name}', 'Visit logged…' or 'Note on…' by kind. Point the description at update_lead for a next action.

gaps.where: Inbox and conversation entries the Assistant may name: My mail, Other mail, Spam, Unread, ⋯ → Video call, Move to… / Always put their mail…, Share with the team, Copy email address, Close every line, Ask for a video, Notes from the call, Switch to video
gaps.gap: 'Close every line' and 'Copy phone number' are already in the conversation entry's onScreen (places-map.ts:85). Missing from places-map: My mail, Other mail, Spam, the Unread toggle, ⋯ → Video call, Move to… / Always put their mail…, Share with the team, Copy email address, Ask for a video, Notes from the call, and Switch to video. grep -i finds no 'video', 'spam', 'messenger', 'instagram' or 'portal' anywhere in places-map.ts. The Inbox entry's 'what' says only 'texts, calls, email and website chat'. canChange omits move, share and close-every-line, though do_conversation_move/share/close_all exist. The prompt (prompt.ts:38) tells the model never to name a place that isn't in the map.
gaps.fix: In packages/core/src/assistant/places-map.ts, Inbox entry (59-77): change what to 'texts, calls, email, website chat, client portal, Messenger and Instagram'. Add onScreen 'My mail (your own Gmail or Outlook) with Inbox, Other mail and Spam' and 'Unread'. Conversation entry (79-117): add to the ⋯ list 'Video call, Move to… / Always put their mail…, Share with the team, Copy email address'. Add to the reply box 'Ask for a video (texts only)', and add 'Notes from the call on a call card' and 'Switch to video on the call bar' with the exact labels from conversation-view.tsx, composer.tsx:903 and active-call-bar.tsx:194/205. gaps.where: Messenger and Instagram conversations: page label, cards, Send again, Hand to AI
